title: Dashboard Import Action Permission Consistency

items.action: start a new import from the Dashboard quick actions

migration.reason: The existing fair_crm.imports.create permission is reused.

backend.reason: Existing import authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contracts change; only Dashboard import-start visibility is aligned with the existing route guard.

tenant_isolation.reason: No backend query or organization-scoping behavior changes.

audit.reason: No mutation or audit behavior changes.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: The /data-integration/imports/new route already requires fair_crm.imports.create; this change aligns the originating Dashboard quick action.

notes: Dashboard previously rendered the Import Baslat quick action for every authenticated organization user even when fair_crm.imports.create was absent. The action now fails closed in the UI and is offered only when import-create permission is granted. Dashboard access itself remains unchanged.
